name: Launggyet Kingdom
native: လောင်းကြက်

successors.name: Kingdom of Mrauk U
successors.text: northern Arakan in the Kaladan valley: 'located in present-day northern Rakhine State', without Sandoway (Thandwe), which stayed independent until 1437

ledger.x: 1237: Alawmaphyu Min founds the Launggyet dynasty on the Kaladan.
18 April 1429: Min Saw Mon is proclaimed king at Launggyet and the dynasty gives way to Mrauk U.

wars.name: Ava's conquest of Arakan (Forty Years' War)
wars.outcome: Ava overran Launggyet on 29 November 1406 and installed a nominee; Pegu dislodged the Avan troops in 1408; Arakan was Pegu's tributary 1412-1421 and Min Saw Mon returned in 1429.

certainty.note: Chronicle history; the pages name a river valley and a capital, not a frontier.
